name: Warbirds Wings 1942
summary:
As a World War II pilot you have to engage with enemy fighter planes with an intense air to air fight. Select from a variety of World War II planes to fly and different maps. Nicely replicated real cockpits and flight control will give you an amazing flying immersive experience. Good luck!

Use you hand controllers to grab and control the plane stick and throttle and look around for enemy and friendly planes. You have unlimited ammo at your disposal so keep your finger the trigger.
